name: map-route-journey
title: Google Road Route Journey
description: Fit the complete Google Directions road geometry and animate a marker between verified GPS stops with smooth travel and endpoint holds.
use: Bridge Vlog scenes with a map route; Google road geometry serves as the displayed route trajectory.
snippet:
## Road-Route
layout:parallel
- map view:route mapType:roadmap duration:8 routeAnimation:{startHold:0.5,endHold:0.7,easing:easeInOut} routeColor:"#4285F4" routeWeight:5 routeMarker:"📍" waypoints:[37.7749,-122.4194,"Start";37.7849,-122.4094,"Finish"]
notes: Replace example waypoints with source-backed GPS in chronological order.
Do not force center or zoom: the renderer fits Google's full road polyline automatically.
duration is editorial screen time, not Google travel ETA; record route geometry source as google_directions.
Use the verified transport mode where known; the default is DRIVING.
